title: Application (25A789) to extend the time to file the reply brief on the merits, submitted to Justice Gorsuch

pages.text:
No. 24-935

IN THE
Supreme Court of the United States

FLOWERS FOODS, INC., ET AL.,
                                                                               Petitioners,
v.
ANGELO BROCK,
                                                                               Respondents.

CORPORATE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT


Pursuant to this Court’s Rule 29.6, Petitioner states as follows:
 Petitioner Flowers Baking Co. of Denver, LLC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of
Petitioner Flowers Bakeries, LLC, which is itself a subsidiary of Petitioner Flowers
Foods, Inc., the ultimate parent company.  Petitioner Flowers Foods, Inc., is a publicly
held corporation whose shares are traded on the New York Stock Exchange.
